subject.title: SQLite snapshot restore lacks end-to-end crash and identity guarantees

question: Should this umbrella remain open solely for native WSL2/Windows Crabbox and ARM32 reliability proof, or should those environment-specific gaps move to narrower follow-ups now that the linked functional fixes are merged?
rationale: The supplied campaign update characterizes the remaining work as proof availability rather than an observed unresolved SQLite defect, but member authorship and the protected `maintainer` label require an explicit human decision rather than automatic cleanup.

options.title: Keep and narrow the umbrella
options.body: Retain the issue with explicit platform-proof exit criteria and close it only after the owner confirms those criteria are met or intentionally waived.

options.title: Split infrastructure follow-ups
options.body: Create focused runner or platform-proof follow-ups, then close this issue after a current-main source and release-provenance recheck confirms the functional bug is resolved.

recommendation.title: Keep and narrow the umbrella
recommendation.body: Retain the issue with explicit platform-proof exit criteria and close it only after the owner confirms those criteria are met or intentionally waived.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is assigned to this person and the supplied history shows sustained ownership of the linked SQLite snapshot reliability work.
